insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to API version 2026-10 and later.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware of this change and ensure their apps handle the updated tax calculations correctly. They should test their apps with different shipping addresses to verify the tax recalculation works as expected. Additionally, developers should review the GraphQL Admin API documentation for any other changes related to tax calculations.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations for their orders, which can help reduce errors and improve customer satisfaction. This change can also help merchants comply with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid errors and potential legal issues. This change ensures that Shopify's GraphQL Admin API provides reliable and up-to-date tax calculations, which is essential for merchants and developers.

also_worth_knowing.text: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing the development experience. This update includes other minor changes.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management. The updateCart standard action updates cart attributes, and a new event fires when an attribute update is initiated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented. This change may require updates to inventory management logic.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores. Agents can search catalogs, manage carts, and initiate checkout on behalf of shoppers.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores. Note that development stores do not include public environments.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing for more accurate and detailed order tracking. A new trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, with new thresholds that better reflect real-world fulfillment operations. These changes aim to make Built for Shopify more achievable for developers.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, allowing developers to build Shopify storefronts with the same Hydrogen API.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.

CLI version 4.6.0 includes several changes, including the removal of deprecated draftable extension processes and dev session support branching. New flags have been added to avoid prompts in app config linking.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making when approving requests. This change aims to enhance trust and confidence in collaborator access.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance performance data, storefront events, and inventory management

themes.title: Performance Data and Analytics
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update enables more informed decision-making for merchants.

themes.title: Storefront and Inventory Management
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed. Additionally, WebMCP support is introduced for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores.
